risks.risk: Whether the fan powers on and works
risks.proof: Video clip of the fan switched on and running through all speed settings

risks.risk: Age or usage history of the fan
risks.proof: Receipt or screenshot showing purchase date
risks.if_unproven: priced as used with unknown wear

risks.risk: Condition of internal motor and wiring
risks.proof: Close-up of motor housing and wiring, or video showing no sparks or burning smell
risks.if_unproven: priced as motor or wiring faulty

risks.risk: Whether height adjustment and oscillation functions work
risks.proof: Clip demonstrating height adjustment and oscillation
risks.if_unproven: priced as fixed height and non-oscillating

risks.risk: Hidden cracks or damage on blades or stand
